classification_reason: Author-confirmed reconstruction strategy (Giovanna Cottin): reconstruct the bm1 SLHA by editing only the gluino/neutralino masses of the public 2800/10 template, generate LHE samples independently, and compare against public HEPData/archived recast results. The exact original author SLHA/LHE/seeds were never recovered and this classification does not claim otherwise -- see the still-UNKNOWN exact_parameter_or_slha_card field below.
